name: Brain Riddle
summary:
Brain Riddle: Tricky Box is a mobile puzzle game developed by BrainPunk Studio, available on Google Play and App Store. The game launched on Android on March 25 and is scheduled for release on iOS at a later date. Built with Unity 6, the game offers a creative, hand-drawn puzzle experience centered around unconventional problem-solving and conceptual gameplay.

Brain Riddle: Tricky Box is a logic-based mobile puzzle game that blends platforming elements with concept-driven challenges. Players control a character within a stylized, hand-drawn environment and solve puzzles by interacting with objects, interpreting hints, and discovering non-obvious solutions.
Unlike traditional puzzle games that rely on fixed mechanics or repetitive patterns, Brainy Boxy emphasizes interpretation, experimentation, and lateral thinking.

Brain Riddle: Tricky Box is a creative and cozy mobile puzzle game that combines interaction-based gameplay with conceptual and unconventional puzzle design. By encouraging players to interpret, experiment, and rethink how the game world works, it delivers a distinctive brain teaser experience centered on insight and discovery.
